acceptanceCriteria: An MCP tool returns the same bytes as `corvint tests validity --files` for a fixture (test)
The TSA header Blocked-on entry is updated
Focused mcp and testsource tests pass
body: Residual from V1-1798 (PR #1150). The new `corvint tests validity --files` command (exits 1 on INELIGIBLE) exists only on the CLI. The TSA header still lists the MCP and preflight surfaces under Blocked on. Expected: an MCP tool with byte-identical output, and an optional preflight check that consumes it.
title: corvint tests validity has no MCP tool and no preflight hookup
